game_build: Mafia: Definitive Edition (PC) - community candidates, UNVERIFIED on current builds
_doc: Every symbol here is a candidate taken from MIT-licensed community projects (see notes). Patterns that do not match your build simply fail and the features that need them are greyed out. Confirm or fix them with the in-game tools and pin working values; see docs/BINDINGS.md. Add Cheat-Engine-style cheats to the cheats array (format: src/features/cheat_table.h).

Game.TickHook.notes: C_ScriptMachine::Tick (reads lua_State from this+0xD0). Pattern from Kamzik123/Mafia3ScriptHook (MIT, 2026) for Mafia III DE - same Hangar 13 engine and Havok Script lineage. Does NOT match Mafia DE Steam build PE 0x6092B6F8 (every other Lua.* symbol does); without it Chroma runs scripts at pcall safe points on the Lua.State pointer instead, so leaving this unresolved is fine.

Lua.ResetState.notes: C_ScriptGameMachine::ResetState, returns 3 when the VM is ready. Kamzik123/Mafia3ScriptHook (MIT), Mafia III DE pattern.

Lua.StateOffset.notes: lua_State* inside C_ScriptMachine. Used by MartinJK's 2020 Mafia DE hook (MIT) and Kamzik123's Mafia III DE hook (MIT).

Lua.State.notes: Global C_ScriptGameMachine* then lua_State at +0xD0. MartinJK/Mafia-Definitive-Edition-ScriptHook M1DE component (MIT, 2020 launch build; its pattern path was disabled in source, it used the hard-coded global RVA 0x6312DA0). Resolves to RVA 0x6315F10 on build 0x6092B6F8. Without Game.TickHook this identifies the main VM for pcall mode; if it is null or wrong, Chroma learns the VM from the game's own pcalls.

Lua.PCall.notes: hksi_lua_pcall(L, nargs, nresults, errfunc). Primary: Kamzik123 (MIT, Mafia III DE). Fallback: MartinJK M1DE (MIT, 2020 Mafia DE call site).

Lua.LoadBuffer.notes: luaL_loadbuffer(L, buf, len, name). Primary: inner tail pattern + function start, Kamzik123 (MIT, Mafia III DE). Fallback: MartinJK M1DE (MIT, 2020 call site).

Lua.PushCClosure.notes: hks_pushcclosure(L, fn, n, debugName, 0, 0). Kamzik123 (MIT, Mafia III DE); fallback MartinJK M1DE (MIT, 2020).

Lua.SetField.notes: hksi_lua_setfield(L, idx, key). Kamzik123 (MIT, Mafia III DE); fallback MartinJK M1DE (MIT, 2020).

Lua.CheckLString.notes: hksi_luaL_checklstring(L, idx, len). Kamzik123 (MIT, Mafia III DE).

Lua.ToLString.notes: lua_tolstring(L, idx, len). MartinJK M1DE (MIT, 2020 Mafia DE). Used only to read error messages.

Lua.GlobalOffset.notes: HksGlobal* in lua_State, right after the 16-byte chunk header (the CallStack then ends at 0x48 where ApiStack.top starts, matching the MIT offsets above). pcall mode uses it to accept every thread of the main VM.

Lua.PCallLock.notes: Serialise worker-thread pcalls with our chunks (Kamzik123 approach, MIT).
